comparison.objective: Uncork a wine bottle while it remains in its cradle.
comparison.physical_skill: Drive a corkscrew into a cork, operate its lever mechanism, and resist extraction forces without displacing the bottle.
comparison.success_condition: Cork fully removed and displaced from the mouth while the bottle stays within cradle pose limits; partial credit covers penetration and partial extraction.
comparison.reason: Shared rotary tool motion and reaction management are generic; cork penetration and high-force extraction do not test precision stop setting, jam-nut countertorque, or retained actuation.
